text: Hi Sarah, following up on yesterday's discussion about the Q3 launch. We do not believe the current timeline is realistic, and we will not be able to meet it without additional resources. The plan covers the marketing rollout, the sales enablement and the customer support ramp. Please review the attached schedule, the budget and the risk register. I think that we should move the beta date forward, and we will need your sign-off before Friday. Thanks for your patience and your help on this, and we will circle back after the leadership meeting.

Team, a few notes before tomorrow's sync. The vendor said... “The migration is on track, and it is not going to be cheap.” We do not expect any further delays, but we will not commit to a firm date until the tests pass. The rollout touches the payment service, the notification service and the reporting pipeline. We also need to review the pricing, the contract and the support terms. If there are objections, let us know early, and we will adjust the plan accordingly.
